authority: Player authorized time montage/acceleration. No new voluntary Shiki speech, actions or thoughts invented. Standing team directive remains: avoid Leaf war activity, remain under protection until clearance.

events.event: An injured Leaf jonin with asymmetrical shallow breathing and chest damage arrives at central hospital; medical team handles and carries behind curtain. Shiki does not volunteer/intervene. Team Kusa is safe at central medical facility.
Purple Four Violet Flames barrier around Hokage lodge collapses; injured Leaf guards arrive reporting opponent fled; Hokage condition not yet confirmed at this moment.

Leaf releases official communication that Third Hokage Hiruzen Sarutobi died in fight against Orochimaru. Orochimaru escaped stadium, allegedly badly injured but exact damage unknown. Leaf continues fighting Sound and suspected Sand attackers in village. Tose and team hear news; Aki asks about war, Tose says invasion now, war if politicians decide.

Night quiet at underground medical center; Leaf reports attackers driven back from main city sectors, mopping-up continues. Neji regained consciousness overnight with fracture in right lower leg and serious soft tissue injuries in left, viable limbs/long recovery; Sasuke right-hand chakra dysfunction improving. Rock Lee stayed by Neji until Neji responded to doctor; Guy escorted him to rest. Dosu's medical status still unconfirmed. Aki swollen immobilized left shin but foot perfusion intact, no evolving compartment syndrome at that time. Ren with recovered healthy shoulders, jokes with Aki.

Konoha mourning Hiruzen; medical supply and patrols after assault; Leaf foreign delegations checked and departure prohibited pending security review. Team Kusa not arrested, hospital defense recorded in reports.

Morino Ibiki, same Leaf examiner from first stage, arrives to Kusa team at central hospital and meets team leader Asumaga Tose, Aki, Ren, Shiki. Presents two registration sheets for Kusa teams, first authentic Shiki/Aki/Ren, second registered later on expedited acceptance and officially marked lost from Forest of Death without complete report. Tose says he did not escort second team but they could have arrived separately. Leaf sent formal request to Kusa; document discrepancies unresolved. Ibiki knows NO secret signal details and does NOT know Shiki's private discussion with Kabuto. Ren protests lack of hard proof, Ibiki limits claims to unresolved documents. Tose protects his team and notes they assisted hospital defense. Ibiki credits that and questions them here instead of detention.

Ibiki addresses all three Kusa genin: «Меня интересуют только сведения, которые вы получили лично. Не слухи. Не догадки. Не выводы задним числом.» He asks: «Кто-нибудь из вас заметил что-либо необычное в поведении второй команды Травы до её исчезновения?» Tose listens to his students. Shiki has not replied. His prior observations of five glances and hand signals between Kabuto and supposedly Grass entrants remain his own knowledge, not disclosed by this scene.

private_continuity.shiki: Owns all decisions and utterances; no unprompted admissions to Ibiki. Previously promised Kabuto not to betray his confidential situation, asked Kabuto not to kill Aki/Ren; Kabuto said no intention to hurt teammates. Five glance signal observation with Grass entrants known to Shiki only.
private_continuity.ren: Fully healed shoulder, ambulatory, independently challenges Ibiki documents.
private_continuity.aki: Broken left fibula without displacement plus incomplete tibial fissure, needs immobilization and monitoring, mentally alert. Still under hospital care.
private_continuity.tose: Asumaga Tose commander of Kusa trio, separate from Asuma Sarutobi Leaf jonin. Doesn't know who second team was, protects students, awaits truthful personal observations.
private_continuity.ibiki: Leaf interrogator/examiner: knows registration discrepancy and defense of infirmary; does NOT know about Kabuto hand-signal exchange or Shiki's private promise and has not accused team of plotting.
